#summary The Mecab-using versions (0.9.2+) crash on some Windows PCs
#labels Phase-Support

== Error symptons ==

When Furigana Injector is installed/upgraded to a version 0.9 ~ 1.3,
firefox crashes whilst trying to start. The error message will be as below:

<pre>
Microsoft Visual C++ Runtime Library Runtime Error!
Program:c\Program Files\Mozilla Firefox\firefox.exe
This application has requested the Runtime to terminate it in an unusual way.
Please contact the application's support team for more information.</pre>

Clicking OK/Debug leads to a further message:

<pre>
firefox.exe-Application Error
The exception unknown software exception (0x40000015) occurred in the application at location 0x10033b1f.
Click on OK to terminate the program
Click on CANCEL to debug the program</pre>

N.B.: messages such "The '!SimpleMecab' XPCOM component could not be loaded." are not related to this issue.

This issue was originally described as issues #13 and #19: http://code.google.com/p/furigana-injector/issues/detail?id=19

== Immediate Fix ==

The way to disable the installed Furigana Injector is start Firefox in safe mode,
e.g. from the command line try running this:

"C:\Program Files\Mozilla Firefox\firefox.exe" -safe-mode

This will start up without using any add-ons. Then you can go to Tools -> Add-ons and disable/uninstall Furigana Injector. When you restart firefox the add-on will be deleted.

== Install the 'No-Mecab' version ==

After uninstalling the ordinary Furigana Injector, download and install <a href="http://furigana-injector.googlecode.com/files/furiganainjectornomecab.0-8-4.winnt.xpi">Furigana Injector (No Mecab) 0.8.4</a>. To install an `*`.xpi file that has been saved to your computer, simply drag it's icon onto the Firefox window.

This add-on has been renamed so it will not be automatically replaced by Mozilla add-ons. The accuracy of readings in this version is not as good as the new versions; furthermore the interface is a little older.

== Further Debugging ==

So far it seems that the cause is that Mecab code cannot run on some PCs (maybe 1%), whether it be by itself or compiled/linked within the Furigana Injector libraries. 

The way to confirm this is to install the ordinary "mecab-win32" package for Mecab, preferably version 0.97 available at <a href="http://sourceforge.net/project/showfiles.php?group_id=177856&package_id=205277&release_id=573517">http://sourceforge.net/project/showfiles.php?group_id=177856&package_id=205277&release_id=573517</a> .

If the error is present the Mecab installation will fail whilst doing the final step of building the dictionaries (either Shift-JIS or UTF-8).

If Mecab does not fail, i.e. can be used to parse japanese text from the commandline, but there was still the runtime error as described above please contact *akira* at *yayakoshi* dot *net*.
